body:
Add new capabilities to solace:
**Discuss**
Discuss could be an option between Runs. Discuss would establish a note-based discussion with an agent who uses only high-level context (to keep things efficient) so that the human can ask questions and create ideas efficiently. The discussion stays in a single run, with all discussion notes compacted into a single note (with author attribute to who said what) at the end of the discussion.
**Stop**
This interrupts a working agent. It ends the agent's session.
title: Additional capabilities: Discuss and Stop
